items.actClause:
AN ACT authorizing the town of Hancock, county of Delaware, to alienate and
convey certain parcels of land used as parklands
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S2458

SPONSOR: AKSHAR
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act authorizing the town of Hancock, county of Delaware, to alienate
and convey certain parcels of land used as parklands

 
PURPOSE:

This bill authorizes the Town of Hancock to alienate and convey the Town
of Hancock Golf Course.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 authorizes the Town of Hancock to discontinue and alienate the
Town of Hancock Golf Course.

Section 2 states that the act shall only take effect upon the condition
that the Town of Hancock shall acquire and dedicate an amount equal or
greater than the fair market value of the parklands being discontinued
towards the acquisition of new parklands and/or towards capital improve-
ments to existing parkland.

Section 3 describes where the lands referred to in section one are
located and bounded.

Section 4 states that the Town of Hancock must comply with any federal
requirements pertaining to alienation if town received any funding,
support or assistance from federal government to purchase, maintain or
improve parklands described in Section 3.

Section 5 establishes the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Town of Hancock, in the County of Delaware, unanimously adopted a
resolution on December 4, 2018 requesting legislation authorizing the
Town to sell their golf course.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
